Struct BlendStateDesc.BlendTarget

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Aura
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Represents a render target blend description since all 8 render targets can have their own individual blend parameters.

Constructors

BlendTarget()

Initializes a new instance of the BlendStateDesc.BlendTarget class with default blending settings. Blending is disabled by default; color writes are enabled for all channels.

public BlendTarget()

BlendTarget(bool)

Initializes a new instance of the BlendStateDesc.BlendTarget class, optionally enabling blending. All other properties retain their default values (e.g., alpha blending with full color write mask).

public BlendTarget(bool enable)

Parameters

enable bool

Whether to enable blending for this render target.

Fields

BlendOp

Specifies the blend operation applied to the RGB components (e.g., addition, subtraction). Typically set to Add for standard alpha blending.

BlendOperation

BlendOpAlpha

Specifies the blend operation applied to the alpha component (e.g., addition, subtraction). Can differ from BlendOp to enable separate alpha blending.

DestinationBlend

Specifies the blend factor used for the RGB components of the destination (existing) color. Common values include InvSrcAlpha and One.

BlendType

DestinationBlendAlpha

Specifies the blend factor used for the alpha component of the destination color. Often matches the RGB destination blend, but can be configured independently.

BlendType

Enabled

Enables or disables blending for this render target. When disabled, the source color is written directly to the target without blending.

public bool Enabled

bool

LogicOp

Specifies the logic operation applied when LogicOpEnabled is true. Used for bitwise operations such as AND, OR, XOR on RGBA values instead of blending.

public BlendLogicOperation LogicOp

BlendLogicOperation

LogicOpEnabled

Enables or disables logic operations (e.g., bitwise operations) on this render target. When enabled, logic operations are applied instead of conventional blending.

bool
